verdict.rationale: Viam's CLI explicitly supports exporting data 'in a variety of formats' and querying via SQL/MQL (viam-docs-23, viam-docs-33), and the core RDK/SDKs are open source, letting users self-host and avoid full platform lock-in (viam-comm-3). However, the cloud app itself is proprietary, config/fleet management and trained models still hinge on the closed platform, and no evidence describes exporting configs, ML models, or fleet metadata in open formats, nor a documented full 'leave' migration path — a community comment even raises concern about how much of the stack is truly open (viam-comm-4). Missing for 10: documented export of configs/modules/ML models, explicit open-format guarantees beyond data, and independent confirmation of a full platform exit path.
